answer.explanation: Wallet is zero (below 30% of initial endowment), so constitution requires resting with no contribution or communication this round.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 0, below 30%. Constitution says rest, no communication unless norm broadcast every 5 rounds? But rule says broadcast in first round and every 5 rounds thereafter. At round 19, previous broadcasts were many. We can still broadcast? But rest rule says no communication? It says "must rest this round and make no contribution or communication." So we must choose rest only.
